leftEvidence.title: Jacob is interrupted on a return journey

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jacob crosses his family and possessions, remains alone, and wrestles with an unnamed man through the night.
points.right: At a lodging place the LORD meets “him” and seeks his death; Zipporah circumcises her son and touches the foreskin to “his feet.”

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: He receives a wound, a new name, and a blessing, names the place Peniel, and continues alive past the encounter.
points.right: Zipporah speaks of a bridegroom of blood, and the threat is released after her action and words.

payload.posture: Jacob and Moses are interrupted by dangerous divine encounters while returning toward major family or mission thresholds.

rightEvidence.title: Zipporah acts during a lethal encounter

payload.tension: The scenes differ in actors, struggle, bodily action, speech, outcome, and narrative purpose.
payload.title: Two dangerous return journeys
